metadata.description: DigiTeam plugins for Claude Cowork and Claude Code — multi-repo feature delivery orchestration.

plugins.name: delivery-orchestrator
plugins.description: Cowork side of the delivery process: locate a feature's phase across repos, run the review gates, hand work to Claude Code, verify integration, author docs.

plugins.name: delivery-executor
plugins.description: Claude Code side of the delivery process: execute a Delivery HandOff in one repo (plan, implement, deploy+verify, review docs, move plan stages) and print a Delivery Report.
